name: My Date With Sven Svensson
source:
It's a nice night out tonight, and you're going on a partially blind date with this 'Sven' guy. However, as the night carries on, things get just slightly weirder every which way, and you're not sure if you should call the authorities.

[from [url=https://stilbie.itch.io/my-date-with-sven-svensson]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今晚天气不错，你要与一个叫“斯文”的家伙，进行一场半盲约会。然而，随着夜色渐深，各方面的事情都变得有点古怪，你开始拿不准，是不是该报警。

[摘自[url=https://stilbie.itch.io/my-date-with-sven-svensson]itch.io[/url]]
